definitions.gloss: advance payment; prepayment; money paid upfront
definitions.explanation: Payment made before goods are delivered or services are rendered. The full amount or a portion paid in advance.

examples.japanese: {前金|まえきん}で{払|はら}ってください。
{前金|まえきん}として{半額|はんがく}を{受|う}け{取|と}った。
examples.english: I received half the amount as an advance payment.

examples.japanese: この{店|みせ}は{前金|まえきん}{制|せい}で、{注文|ちゅうもん}{時|じ}に{全額|ぜんがく}{支払|しはら}う{必要|ひつよう}がある。
examples.english: This shop operates on a prepayment system, requiring full payment at the time of order.

notes:
A compound of {前|まえ} (before, in advance) and {金|きん} (money). The opposite is {後金|あときん} (payment after delivery). Common in business transactions, rental agreements, and service contracts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {前金|まえきん}で{払|はら}う: to pay in advance
- {前金|まえきん}{制|せい}: prepayment system
- {前金|まえきん}として: as an advance payment
- {前金|まえきん}を{受|う}け{取|と}る: to receive advance payment

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {手付金|てつけきん}: deposit, earnest money — specifically a partial payment that secures an agreement
- {頭金|あたまきん}: down payment — the initial payment in an installment plan
- {前払|まえばら}い: prepayment — similar meaning, slightly more general in usage
